note: Names for virtual slots the Blair Witch builds added, which nocedit has no method for. `class` is the class whose part struct introduces the slot; `slot` is the build's own index. `params` follow this_ptr. Only names whose basis settles them are listed; the rest stay vfuncN. Read by build_vtable_structs.py and name_vtable_slot_functions.py (--slot-names) and rendered by actor_hierarchy_report.py.

slots.name: markResourcesInUse
slots.basis: CCharacter's override marks its model (+0x24a8) and skeleton in use in their pools; the mission's actor setup clears the marks, calls this slot on every actor, purges what is unmarked, then calls setup.

slots.name: toggleGoggles
slots.basis: Called when CGame+0x54 (nocedit key_infrared) is pressed; CDoc's override flips its CGoggles item.

slots.name: canReachPickup
slots.basis: The pickup search calls it per nearby actor with canPickup()'s result and a running best distance; success enters pickup state 4.

slots.name: doHeroAction
slots.basis: Body strings "CHero::doHeroAction - type=eHeroAction...".

slots.name: canDoHeroAction
slots.basis: The action selector asks it for each action type before trying that action.

slots.name: playChaseSound
slots.basis: Plays "demn_<name>_chase?.wav" or "_taunt?.wav".

slots.name: playHurtSound
slots.basis: Plays "demn_<name>_hurt?.wav".

slots.name: playDeathSound
slots.basis: Plays "demn_<name>_die.wav".

slots.name: playFeedingSound
slots.basis: Plays "ghoul-dig-?.wav" or "ghoul-eat-?.wav".

slots.name: damageSack
slots.basis: Adds the hit's damage to the sack slot 83 maps it to; past the threshold spawns a body part and fires the "DjienSackBlown" event.

slots.name: getSackIndex
slots.basis: Returns 0..5 for the six sack part ids at +0xc2b0..+0xc2c4, -1 for any other.

slots.name: setCharacterModel
slots.basis: Dispatched by the script command "setCharacterModel(actor, model, cloth)".

slots.name: canReachPickup
slots.basis: Called by the pickup search, as bw1 slot 85.

slots.name: doHeroAction
slots.basis: Body strings "CHero::doHeroAction - type=...".

slots.name: canDoHeroAction
slots.basis: Body identical to bw1 slot 87; dispatched by the action selector.

slots.name: setInventoryIndex
slots.basis: Called by the script command "setInventoryIndex(%d)".

slots.name: processBurnState
slots.basis: The state dispatcher calls it in state "Burn".

slots.name: advanceMotion
slots.basis: Advances the motion controller by dt; motion events above 100 go to slot 90, the rest to CCharacter_processMotion.

slots.name: processStates
slots.basis: Mode 0 registers the class's state names, mode 1 runs the current state's handler.

slots.name: processMotionEvent
slots.basis: Receives motion events above 100 from slot 87; overrides play the event's sound or apply its melee damage.

slots.name: startBurn
slots.basis: The cross's blast calls it on each living enemy in range; a burnable enemy enters state "Burn".

slots.name: processAnimationState
slots.basis: The state dispatcher calls it in state "Animation".

slots.name: checkVictim
slots.basis: Returns 1 while the victim (+0x10a78) is alive; otherwise clears it and returns to the previous state.
